Thanks for the repro. I found the likely cause in `packages/browser/src/client/public/error-catcher.js` (`catchWindowErrors`, lines 29-36).

The `ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications` error fires a window `error` event whose `event.error` is `null`. The message is only on `event.message`. Because `e[prop] != null` is false, the code goes to the `else` branch and calls `console.error(e[prop])`, which prints `null`. All the useful information is dropped.

I searched existing issues and found no exact duplicate. #7675 is related: it asks for a way to ignore specific unhandled errors.

I haven't run your repro myself. This is from reading the source. A fix would probably log `e.message` when `e.error` is null, or ignore this benign error. Which of those is right is still undecided.
